description: This source file defines the AcknowledgementForwarderActor class, an Akka actor implementation in Java for handling acknowledgements in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages forwarding of acknowledgment responses, handles timeouts, and orchestrates actor creation based on message headers.

classes.name: AcknowledgementForwarderActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for forwarding acknowledgment responses to the original requester, handling timeout scenarios, and managing its own lifecycle based on signal headers and acknowledgements.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates the Props configuration object needed to instantiate this actor with specific parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, including processing acknowledgement responses, handling timeouts, and logging unexpected messages.

methods.name: forwardCommandResponse
methods.description: Forwards the received acknowledgment or command response to the original requester actor.

methods.name: handleReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Handles the scenario where the actor times out waiting for acknowledgments, resulting in stopping itself.

methods.name: determineActorName
methods.description: Generates the actor's name based on the correlation ID extracted from DittoHeaders; throws exception if missing.

methods.name: startAcknowledgementForwarderForTest
methods.description: Test utility for starting an acknowledgment forwarder actor within a given actor context, entity, signal, and config.

methods.name: startAcknowledgementForwarder
methods.description: Creates and starts an acknowledgment forwarder actor in the specified context, configuring headers and acknowledgments based on signal and configuration.
